name: Dan
bio: Dan is the first son born to Jacob through Rachel's servant Bilhah. After years of barrenness, Rachel had given Bilhah to Jacob; when this son was born, Rachel said, "God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son," and named him "Dan," meaning "he judged" or "vindicated" (Genesis 30:6). Dan later became one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
